title: Fix Callaway chart data table to match provided 13x11 grid (row + 5 gross/deduction pairs)

quotes: It will have 13 rows with 11 columns, the first column is the row number the next two columns are gross score and how many holes to deduct respectively, corresponding to Col 1 adjustment and so on for the next 8 columns

acceptanceCriteria: On a fresh install (no localStorage chart data), the 18-hole chart grid renders the exact gross/deduction values listed above (with placeholders where the user supplied zeros).
All worst-holes/deduction values support 0.5 increments and are stored without rounding.
No extra rows/columns are added or removed (13 rows, 5 chart columns, with row-number plus 10 value columns in the UI table).

requirements.text: Ensure users who already have older shipped 18-hole defaults cached in localStorage automatically receive the updated shipped 18-hole defaults when appropriate. Specifically: if the stored active grid chart and/or stored user-default grid chart exactly matches the previously shipped 18-hole defaults, clear those localStorage entries so the new shipped defaults are used.

quotes: the data table is still not correct.

acceptanceCriteria: If localStorage contains the prior shipped 18-hole grid defaults, reloading the app results in the new shipped 18-hole defaults being used (without the user needing to manually reset).
If localStorage contains a user-edited chart that does NOT equal the prior shipped defaults, the app does not overwrite it.

requirements.text: Fix the chart table UI so placeholder cells (grossScore = 0 and worstHoles = 0) are displayed as blank/empty cells (not literal zeros) wherever the chart grid is shown/edited, while keeping the underlying stored value as 0 for those placeholders.

quotes: the data table is still not correct.

acceptanceCriteria: In the Callaway chart editor and any chart display table, cells whose grossScore and worstHoles are both 0 render as empty rather than showing “0”.
Saving the chart preserves placeholder cells as (0,0) values in persisted chart data.
Chart calculations continue to ignore placeholder grossScore=0 cells (i.e., placeholders do not affect scoring).

requirements.text: Align backend Callaway chart logic with the updated 18-hole chart behavior used by the frontend, using the same gross-to-deduction mapping (including 0.5 deductions) so backend net score outputs match frontend results for the same hole scores and course par.

quotes: the data table is still not correct.
It will have 13 rows with 11 columns... gross score and how many holes to deduct

acceptanceCriteria: For any gross score present in the provided table (72 through 130), the backend selects the same deduction holes value as the frontend chart mapping.
Backend supports 0.5 deduction holes (e.g., 0.5, 1.5, 2.5, etc.) consistently with frontend behavior.
Given identical input scores + par, backend net score equals frontend net score (for 18-hole events).

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep all Motoko logic in the single actor at backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo changes if state upgrade is required.
Use English for any user-facing UI strings introduced or modified by these changes.
nonGoals: Do not add new authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
Do not introduce new chart formats beyond the existing 13x5 grid + column adjustments model.
Do not change the 9-hole chart defaults unless required for this 18-hole table fix.
